faq.q: Is my image uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. All processing happens entirely in your browser. Your images never leave your device.
Drake, Distracted Boyfriend, Woman Yelling at Cat, Two Buttons, and Custom (upload your own). More templates are coming soon!

faq.q: Can I use my own image as a template?
faq.a: Yes! Click the upload area or drag and drop any image. It will be used as the meme background, and you can add top/bottom text to it.

faq.q: What is the best font size?
faq.a: The default 60px works well for most standard memes. For tall images, increase to 80-100px. For wide images with short text, 40-50px may look better. Always preview before downloading.

faq.q: Why does my text look blurry?
faq.a: This can happen if the canvas is very large and the font size is small. Try increasing the font size slider, or use a taller image template.

faq.q: Can I use this for commercial purposes?
faq.a: You retain full rights to memes you create. Note: some meme templates may be copyrighted images — for commercial use, use your own images or properly licensed templates.

faq.q: What output format should I use?
faq.a: PNG is recommended for maximum quality and sharp text. JPG produces smaller files but may introduce compression artifacts around high-contrast text. WebP is a good modern alternative with excellent compression.
